subject: general
question: Alarmel Valli is a __________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alarmel Valli** is an acclaimed Indian classical dancer known for her expertise in **Bharatnatyam**.
 
• **Bharatnatyam** is one of the **oldest classical dance forms** of India, originating from the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is characterized by its fixed upper torso, bent legs and knees flexed out combined with spectacular footwork, and sophisticated vocabulary of hand and facial gestures.
 
• Alarmel Valli has been awarded several prestigious accolades for her contribution to the art form, including the **Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The origins of Bharatnatyam can be traced back to the **Natya Shastra**, an ancient Indian treatise on the performing arts.
 
• It is traditionally performed by women, and has its roots in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The dance form was revived in the early 20th century by pioneers like **Rukmini Devi Arundale and E. Krishna Iyer**.
 
• In modern times, Bharatnatyam is performed by both men and women and has gained global recognition.
 
• Bharatnatyam performances typically involve a solo dancer who performs a variety of items, each with a distinct mood and meaning.
